newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Eco names Steelhammer chairman.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Eco names Steelhammer chairman.

text.p: LITTLE ROCK, Ark., June 30, 1997 - Consolidated Eco-Systems Inc said Monday it named Robert Steelhammer chairman of the board.
Steelhammer is a partner of Steelhammer & Miller, P.C. of Houston, Texas, an international law firm.
He replaces Edward Schrader, who is leaving to pursue a career in teaching, Consolidated chief financial officer Ed Penick said.
